name: Sorihuela del Guadalimar (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper fly to the lower hoist, green at the upper hoist and red at the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Sorihuela del Guadalimar (a castle on green and a sword on red).
history: The flag has proportions of 2:3 and is divided diagonally into two triangular zones: the upper one, at the hoist, is green, and the lower one, at the fly, is red.

features.role: Sorihuela del Guadalimar arms — castle on green and sword on red
castle, sword and crown of the arms
